# XMesh Sub

Standalone subscription delivery edge for [XMesh Nexus](https://github.com/TriplexCorp/XMesh-Nexus).

**Phase 1 — secure delivery gateway.** Install XMesh-Sub on a clean Ubuntu VPS using the command generated by Nexus → Subscription Studio. The gateway exposes only the configured subscription token path plus the legacy `/sub/{token}` and `/portal/{token}` paths; all other requests return 404. XMesh Nexus remains the source of truth for subscriptions, tokens, access decisions, and client configuration. **This is not yet an independent subscription generator**.

Production safeguards: automatic HTTPS through Caddy, no access logging configured, no API/database secrets stored on the edge, no route to panel administration, upstream certificate verification, an explicit 64-hex-character URL token matcher, no caching, and a readiness endpoint at `/healthz`.

The initial installer and integration are being implemented in a feature branch. Do not point live subscription DNS at an untested instance.
